Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.imageeditor

Class UndoStack<T>

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.imageeditor.UndoStack<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the snapshot type
public final class UndoStack<T> extends Object
A bounded undo / redo stack of immutable state snapshots. The caller pushes the pre-edit state before mutating, then undo(Object) swaps the current state for the last snapshot (moving the current one onto the redo stack) and vice-versa for redo(Object).

Generic and AWT-free, so it is unit-testable headless with any snapshot type (the editor uses EditorDocument).
